disclaimer: Demo environment · synthetic data. Walkthroughs show demo builds, not production customer data.

ecosystem.title: One loop across three products
ecosystem.text: A policy is generated from the risk register, the AI assets it governs are registered and monitored, and an incident is triaged with an AI assistant grounded in alert records.

chapters.label: Alert feed, triaged by severity
chapters.decision: Severity-first queue, with owner and status on every alert.

chapters.label: Incident with linked alerts
chapters.decision: Related alerts roll into one incident and keep the comment trail for audit.
chapters.metric: End-to-end median time to resolve · Good ≤ 8h

chapters.label: AI assistant grounded in alert records
chapters.decision: Answers only from alert records. No invented hosts or indicators.
chapters.metric: AI acceptance rate and % positive AI feedback

chapters.label: KPI metrics for analysts
chapters.decision: MTTD, MTTR and false-positive rate shown against targets, not hidden in a report.

chapters.label: Threat intelligence
chapters.decision: Indicators link to live alerts instead of sitting in a separate feed.

chapters.label: Role-based reports
chapters.decision: Scheduled executive summaries so leaders don’t need the console.
chapters.metric: Alerts worked per day, daily active analysts

chapters.label: Sign up with role and department
chapters.decision: Capture the role at sign-up so each persona lands on the right view.

chapters.label: Posture dashboard
chapters.decision: One posture trend and the live alerts above the fold.
chapters.metric: North star: accounts running assessments every week

chapters.label: Register an AI asset
chapters.decision: Every model and dataset carries environment, risk level and data classification.
chapters.metric: Assets registered, by type and risk level

chapters.label: Real-time monitoring
chapters.decision: Applied ML and rules, not an LLM, so blocking stays fast and cheap.
chapters.metric: Critical vs high alert time to resolve · Good: critical faster

chapters.label: Add a compliance framework
chapters.decision: Frameworks such as NIST AI RMF are data, so a new regulation needs no code.

chapters.label: Run an assessment
chapters.decision: A score per asset per framework, with recommendations.

chapters.label: Executive briefing
chapters.decision: Lead with the business case and ROI before the product.
chapters.metric: Claim to test: policies in under 24 hours

chapters.label: Policy dashboard
chapters.decision: Active policies, pending reviews and the live threat feed in one view.

chapters.label: Upload the risk register
chapters.decision: Generate from the organisation’s own risk register, not generic templates.

chapters.label: Configure and generate
chapters.decision: Structured inputs (service, business unit, environment, framework) constrain the agents.

chapters.label: Clause-level traceability
chapters.decision: Every clause traces back to a risk and a control. Traceability came before multi-cloud breadth.

chapters.label: Edit, export and rate
chapters.decision: A person edits and rates every policy before it ships.

chapters.label: Threat intelligence correlation
chapters.decision: New CVEs flag the policies they affect.

chapters.label: Executive scorecard
chapters.decision: Split relationship NPS from per-interaction NPS.

chapters.label: Medical AI trust KPIs
chapters.decision: Domain measures NPS can’t capture: anxiety relief, comprehension, inaccuracy flags.

chapters.label: Survey funnel and feature NPS
chapters.decision: NPS by feature and cohort, to find where trust breaks.

chapters.label: Root cause and aspect sentiment
chapters.decision: Separate detractor volume from detractor severity, by aspect.

chapters.label: Closed-loop verbatim hub
chapters.decision: Every detractor gets an owner and an SLA.

chapters.label: Page clinical on-call
chapters.decision: Safety signals page a clinician, decided by rules a person can audit.

chapters.label: Closed-loop pipeline
chapters.decision: Risk gate → PHI redaction → aspect sentiment → routing, in that order.
chapters.metric: North star: zero unrouted safety signals

chapters.label: Session telemetry
chapters.decision: Product telemetry sits beside the survey data.

chapters.label: The farmer never opens a browser
chapters.decision: WhatsApp and voice are the product. The web is the insurer’s console.
chapters.metric: Purchase funnel, by channel and language

chapters.label: Onboard in one message
chapters.decision: Identity from the WhatsApp number and survey number. No Aadhaar on the channel.

chapters.label: File a claim by voice note
chapters.decision: Regional-language voice; below 0.70 confidence it falls back to a person.

chapters.label: A photo is evidence, not a payout
chapters.decision: A 500 m geofence checks the photo, and photos never trigger payment.

chapters.label: Advice before a loss
chapters.decision: Weather and market nudges keep farmers engaged between claims.

chapters.label: Automatic parametric payout
chapters.decision: 21 dry days under 5 mm pays without anyone filing a claim.

chapters.label: Same answers on a keypad phone
chapters.decision: A basic-phone voice menu for farmers without WhatsApp.

chapters.label: Underwriter desk
chapters.decision: The insurer sees the rule and the rainfall, not just a decision.
chapters.metric: Claim approval rate, insurer daily users
